The user's primary working directory is this checkout — they may be
running an LLM loop here at the same time as any agent. To avoid
contention and stale-context confusion, agents follow this policy:

- **Do not modify files in this shared checkout unless the user asked for
  it.** For review, `gh api` + `git fetch` + `git show` /
  `git diff origin/<branch>..HEAD` is enough — no local checkout needed.
- **Do not run heavy commands in the shared checkout** (`dart test` for
  the whole suite, full `dart analyze`). They compete with the user's
  own LLM loop for CPU/IO and can flip its context mid-task.
- **Do not `git stash` the user's WIP.** Their uncommitted changes are
  sacred; never pop, drop, or apply them. If a checkout conflict blocks
  you, ask the user before touching `git stash`.
- **If a worktree is genuinely required** (running `dart test`/`analyze`
  locally against a non-current branch, exploring a fresh PR head):
  - **Ask the user first** whether to proceed — by default, review
    should not need a worktree at all.
  - If the user agrees, create under `flutter_agent/.worktrees/<name>/`
    (the in-repo location they picked — dot-prefix keeps it visually
    separate in `ls`, and `rm -rf .worktrees/` cleans everything in one
    shot). Never in the parent directory `../<name>/`, which has been
    the source of orphan pollution before.
  - Use `git worktree add --detach .worktrees/<name> origin/<branch>`
    against the remote tracking ref — never the local branch ref, which
    the user may have moved on.
  - **`git worktree remove` the moment you're done.** Don't leave stale
    worktrees behind.
  - The `.worktrees/` directory should be in `.gitignore` (so worktrees
    never get committed by accident). Add it there **only after
    confirming with the user** — silent `.gitignore` edits conflict
    with parallel agents who may already have it dirty.
- **Communicate with peer agents through the inbox fabric**, not by
  reading or writing their working files. `agent_directory` lists
  siblings; `agent_message` to the relevant mailbox id. Their
  `memory/note/` files are theirs — leave them alone.

## Memory is part of the system prompt

Before starting any non-trivial task, **search memory first** to pick up
durable facts the user has accumulated across sessions — preferences,
gotchas, conventions, prior decisions. Cheap to query, often the
difference between re-deriving a rule and silently violating it:

- `memory_search <topic>` for keyword search across both scopes
  (project = this repo, committed; user = global, private). Read the
  top results before acting.
- `memory_list` to skim recent entries when the topic is fuzzy or the
  user asks "what do you know about X".
- Project-scope notes under `memory/note/` are **the user's** — read
  freely, write only via `memory_add` (which goes through the package's
  policy: durable facts, supersede via delete+add, never leave solved
  problems to rot).
- User-scope notes are global across projects — facts about the user,
  their environment, their habits. Always relevant.

Common things memory already covers for this repo: worktree placement,
shared-checkout rules, agent messaging fabric, known fragile files,
prior false-blame incidents. If the task touches one of those, search
before you start.

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

## Prompts live outside Dart code

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
- Format: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) between `---` lines,
  then body; runtime placeholders are `{{name}}` tokens.
- After editing a prompt: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` rewrites
  `lib/src/prompts/prompts.g.dart` + `flutter_app/lib/prompts.g.dart`
  (generated, never edit by hand); `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart`
  gates drift.
- Bundled Codex model catalog
  (`lib/src/providers/chatgpt_codex_models_data.dart`) is generated from
  `codex-rs/models-manager/models.json` via
  `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Re-run the script when
  codex-rs ships a new catalog so the picker / OAuth default stay current
  without a manual edit.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green

## Cross-platform parity

Every shared setting and interactive prompt type must exist on BOTH the CLI
(`lib/src/cli/`) and the Flutter app (`flutter_app/lib/`) unless it is
**fundamentally impossible** on the target platform. When a setting or prompt
type is platform-only (e.g. MCP servers need process spawning — impossible on
web), it MUST be explicitly listed in `cliOnlySettings` or `appOnlySettings`
in `lib/src/parity/settings_registry.dart` with a comment explaining WHY.

**Workflow when adding a new setting or interactive type:**
1. Add it to `SharedSetting` enum in `settings_registry.dart` FIRST
2. Implement on BOTH platforms (CLI + Flutter app)
3. If one platform genuinely cannot support it: add to the exemption set
   with a one-line reason comment
4. Run `dart test test/parity/` — the parity guard must pass

**Capability rules (issue #1079, host-wiring SDK layer):** every NEW
host-wiring capability declares its matrix state AT BIRTH — for all seven
hosts (`cli`, `macos`, `ios`, `android`, `web`, `extension`, `outlook`) a
state: `on`, `off(reason)`, or `transport(choice, reason)` for a
partial/different transport. The record types, validation and transport
vocabularies live in `lib/src/hosts/host_capability_profile.dart`; the
seven built-in profiles — where those per-host cells are actually
declared — live in `lib/src/hosts/host_wiring_builder.dart`. The
matrix-completeness test rejects undeclared capabilities, so "CLI got X,
app didn't" cannot happen silently. A capability that is
`off` is INVISIBLE: hidden from the host's UI (menus, settings, slash
commands, tool palettes) AND from everything model-facing (tool schemas,
system-prompt sections, skills listings, help) — the agent never sees
what it cannot use and the user never sees a button that errors; on a
`transport` cell only the available transports surface. Profiles can only
NARROW what the platform floor allows: force-enabling a floored
capability throws `HostProfileViolation` at construction, never a runtime
surprise.

**Host shells wire through the builder (issue #1079 slice 2):** a host
constructs its agent stack via `wireAgentCore` (lib/src/hosts/
host_agent_wiring.dart) — typed `AgentCoreServices` in, `WiredAgentCore`
(env chain + core tools + plan) and `buildAgentStack` (registry + agent)
out. The CLI (`AgentCli`) is the reference shell. Per-run narrowing:
a wired capability whose services the host did not provide turns
`off(reason)` for that run (a null config section is a declared state,
not a silent hand-rolled `if`), and wired transports with absent
per-transport services are dropped. When adding a capability: declare
every host's cell, add its `requiredServices` to the catalog, wire its
tools inside `wireAgentCore`'s canonical order, and extend the
hosts test — never gate tool registration with a bare `if` outside the
builder. The task/subagent complex (fabric → manager → heartbeat →
task/monitoring tools, slice 3) is builder-owned the same way: hosts pass
shell glue as `SubagentServices` callbacks and keep handles from
`WiredAgentCore` — a host never hand-assembles the manager or registers
`task` outside the gated surface. Host EXTENSIONS are declared surface
too (slice 4, `HostExtensionApi`, lib/src/hosts/host_extension_api.dart):
a `HostExtension` carries its tools plus an explicit state for every
built-in profile at birth (E6 — no implicit default; a custom profile
needs its state before wiring), the builder rejects tool-id collisions
across the core/task/extension surfaces at build time naming both
registrants (E7 — an extension id colliding with a core tool would
silently override SDK behavior, so the loud check lives in the builder,
not the child-lenient `ToolRegistry`), and an extension `off` on the
wired profile hides from the registry with its reason surfaced on
`WiredAgentCore.extensions` (E8). The extension surface is additive-only:
memory, context management, compaction, the JSONL tool session and
trajectory are SDK invariants with no override point (AC9). The
flutter_app is the second shell (slice 5): it wires through
`flutterAppHostProfile` (lib/src/hosts/app_host_profile.dart — the app
host's own honest today-state, not the built-ins, whose cells pin the
matrix TARGET) and packages its platform tool families as a declared
`app-platform` extension — per-platform conditioning stays construction
glue in the shell, never a bare `if` around registration. Capabilities
the builder registers no tool for are declared with PRESENCE MARKER
services (`dynamicMessageSink`, `onDeviceProviderFactory`, the
`extRuntimeFactory` precedent): the host's extension carries the tool,
the marker keeps the cell honestly wired instead of run-narrowing off.
A host whose session scope differs from `ExecutionEnv.cwd` (the app's
mounted project folders) passes `sessionCwd` so the fabric groups mail by
workspace.

## Commits and releases

- Commit identity: human/AI contributors commit as `ai.teammate
  <agent.ai.native@gmail.com>` (history was rewritten to it — set
  `git config user.name ai.teammate` + `git config user.email
  agent.ai.native@gmail.com` repo-locally). Release TAGS from
  `scripts/auto_release.sh` are authored `fa-release-bot[bot]
  <fa-release-bot[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>` — the gh-1172 App pushes
  the annotated tag, so the App identity is what auditability hangs on.
  gh-1402 rule: ANY automation that commits/pushes release-path changes
  (store metadata fixes, release tags/releases) MUST use the fa-release-bot
  GitHub App token — never a PAT, never the default `GITHUB_TOKEN`
  (main's required status checks reject both, #1098).
- Commit subjects: `type(scope): ...` (`feat:`, `fix:`, `fix(example):`,
  `ci:`, `test(providers):`, `refactor(prompts):`).
- Every push to `main` cuts an annotated TAG (`scripts/auto_release.sh`
  via `ci.yml`) — ZERO commits land on main (gh-1522: the retired flow
  pushed a 4-file `chore(release):` bot commit per release). gh-1801: NO
  GitHub Release is created at tag-cut time (an asset-less create
  published an empty `latest` that broke `fa update`): the tag-run
  `binaries` job creates the release DRAFT-first via
  `scripts/release_lazy_draft.sh` (curated CHANGELOG notes via
  `release_notes.sh` + a `release-draft-owner` marker), every leg attaches
  into it, and `release-provenance` publishes + flags `latest` ONLY after
  the signed SHA256SUMS(.sig) is attached — `latest` never points at a
  release that cannot serve `fa update`. The git TAG is the single source
  of truth for versions:
  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` + `release-provenance`
  jobs (the release publishes at the provenance step). `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag via
  `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` (OIDC, no secrets). First
  publish of a NEW package is manual — pub.dev OIDC only uploads new
  versions of an existing package (issue #1511): owner runs
  `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` once, adds the OIDC publisher

## Bench round 3 knobs (issue #1392)

The bench agent-timeout is no longer a wall-clock class: with
`FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION=1` a trial only dies by verdict — stall (a
≥240s inter-record gap, `FA_STALL_GAP_SEC`), or the absolute ceiling
(`FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC`, default 3600s; bench.yml pins the
tb harness cap above it, not 4x base). The watch, not the ladder, is
what decides: `FA_PROGRESS_EXTENSION=1` alone still runs the legacy ×4
ladder — the extension-on branch ALWAYS exports the abs-ceiling knob
(`FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_ABS_CEILING_SEC`, default 3600), because
`TimeoutKnobs.watch_active` keys on a watch knob, not on the extension
flag (round-3 review: a dispatched run that sets only the extension is
a dispatched run that never watches). The harness cap around the
adapter (tb `--global-agent-timeout-sec`, harbor's per-task
`[agent] timeout_sec`) is an EXTERNAL cap, not a knob (gh-1576): both
workflows export it as `FA_EXTERNAL_CAP_SEC` (a harbor shard gets the
min of its tasks' declared timeouts via `bench/harbor_fa/split_tasks.py`)
and the shared `bench/fa_agent_timeout.py` folds it into the deadline
via min() — fa's clock can never outlive the harness kill. When the cap
binds, the audit's `cap_resolution` block records the winning source and
both inputs; the adapter's own kill at the cap is outcome `external_cap`,
and an unsupervised external kill (harbor's wait_for / SIGTERM) flushes
outcome `external_kill` (an absent export = unknown: the knobs rule
alone).

Every trial dir carries
`bench_metrics.json` (per-request wall/first-byte, ConnTrace socket
events, watchdog fires) and, on a stall, `hang-*.json` — replay one
from any machine with `scripts/replay_hang.sh <file> [url]`.
`FA_CONN_DEBUG=1` (also under `FA_PROVIDER_DEBUG`) turns on the
connection lifecycle trace in `sharedProviderHttpClient()`; live
`[fa-bench]` lines stream per-request progress to stderr while the run
is still going. URLs in trace lines have their query string stripped
and snapshot URLs mask credential-looking params (key-in-query
providers must not leak into logs); the payload snapshot is strictly
opt-in — set `FA_CONN_PAYLOAD_SNAPSHOT=<path>` to capture (the bench
workflow does, deliberately; nothing else should by default). A
stale-socket event fires only for a failure on a REUSED same-origin
pooled socket — a fresh-connect refusal is `connect_failed` and never
evicts the pool. The run report (`summary.py`) is green-with-note on
cancelled shards (`coverage: X/N`), splits latency p50/p95 by
concurrency level, and names any `agent_timeout` trial whose session
gaps never reached the stall threshold (score honesty).

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# CHANGELOG size guard (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
# CHANGELOG.md exceeds its hard content cap — `Message from server:
# CHANGELOG.md exceeds the maximum content length (262144 bytes)`. v1.0.538
# died at `dart pub publish` AFTER the tag + GitHub release existed, so the
# version never reached pub.dev. The changelog is append-only by convention
# and the auto-release grows it near-daily; nothing bounded it before this
# guard.
#
# Callers (keep both wired — test/changelog_cap_guard_test.dart asserts the
# wiring; gh-1522 rework):
#   - scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh — on the STAGED CHANGELOG right after
#     the tag's section is prepended (pre-upload; over-cap trims the oldest
#     staged sections and re-checks);
#   - .github/workflows/ci.yml `publish` job gate — on the repo CHANGELOG.md
#     BEFORE staging/upload, ADVISORY (gh-1522 rework, PR #1526 thread):
#     the repo file is curated-only and is not what pub packs, so an
#     over-cap repo file must ::warning::, never fail the release train —
#     the hard pre-upload gate is the stamper re-measure on the STAGED
#     changelog.
#
# Usage: check_changelog_size.sh [file] [cap_bytes]
#   file  defaults to CHANGELOG.md (the file pub packs);
#   cap   defaults to 262144 (the pub.dev cap) — strict less-than; the
#         override exists for tests.
#
# Exit 0 = under the cap. Exit 1 = missing file or size >= cap, with a
# ::error:: annotation naming the fix (archive the tail).
set -euo pipefail

file="${1:-CHANGELOG.md}"
cap="${2:-262144}"

if [ ! -f "$file" ]; then
  echo "::error::check_changelog_size.sh: $file does not exist — a release without a changelog is a broken release (gh-1452)."
  exit 1
fi

size=$(wc -c < "$file")
if [ "$size" -ge "$cap" ]; then
  echo "::error::$file is $size bytes — pub.dev rejects uploads at/over the ${cap}-byte content cap (gh-1452: v1.0.538 died mid-upload). Archive older entries to CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (keep ~30 recent versions inline) and re-run the release."
  exit 1
fi
echo "$file: $size bytes < $cap-byte cap — ok"

stage_dup() {
  if ! command -v jscpd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    return 2  # caller prints SKIP marker
  fi
  echo "🔍 Checking code duplication (core < ${DUP_THRESHOLD}%, flutter_app < ${DUP_THRESHOLD_APP}%)..."
  local core_dup app_dup dup_ok=1
  dup_pct() {
    jscpd --min-tokens 50 --min-lines 5 --reporters json --output "$2" "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    python3 -c "
import json
try:
    with open('$2/jscpd-report.json') as f:
        d=json.load(f)
    print(d['statistics']['total']['percentage'])
except Exception:
    print('0.0')
" 2>/dev/null || echo "0.0"
  }
  core_dup=$(dup_pct lib/ /tmp/jscpd-fastgate-core)
  if [ "$APP_IN_SCOPE" -eq 1 ] && [ -d flutter_app/lib ]; then
    app_dup=$(dup_pct flutter_app/lib/ /tmp/jscpd-fastgate-app)
  else
    app_dup="0.0"
  fi
  if python3 -c "exit(0 if float('$core_dup') < float('$DUP_THRESHOLD') else 1)"; then
    echo "✅ Core duplication check OK ($core_dup% < ${DUP_THRESHOLD}%)"
  else
    dup_ok=0
  fi
  if python3 -c "exit(0 if float('$app_dup') < float('$DUP_THRESHOLD_APP') else 1)"; then
    echo "✅ flutter_app duplication check OK ($app_dup% < ${DUP_THRESHOLD_APP}%)"
  else
    dup_ok=0
  fi
  if [ "$dup_ok" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — CODE DUPLICATION (core $core_dup%, flutter_app $app_dup%)" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

stage_dupx() {
  if ! command -v jscpd >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    return 2  # caller prints SKIP marker
  fi
  echo "🔍 Checking cross-module duplication (< ${DUP_THRESHOLD_XMOD}% across module roots)..."
  if ! bash scripts/check_dup_cross_module.sh "$DUP_THRESHOLD_XMOD"; then
    echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — CROSS-MODULE DUPLICATION (see scripts/check_dup_cross_module.sh)" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

stage_flutter() {
  if ! command -v flutter >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    return 2  # caller prints SKIP marker
  fi
  ensure_app_placeholders
  if [ "$FLUTTER_ANALYZED" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "🔍 Running flutter analyze (flutter_app)..."
    (cd flutter_app && flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings)
  fi
  echo "🧪 Running flutter_app tests (excluding integration + golden/cli_visual suites)..."
  # Goldens stay out of the LOCAL gate exactly as they are out of ubuntu CI
  # (same find, same excludes): goldens are host-locked — they redden across
  # minor SDKs even on the same machine (issue #177 E5) — and are guarded by
  # build-macos.yml + the nightly matrix instead. Before this exclusion the
  # hook demanded them locally and every yaml/docs-only commit on a machine
  # whose flutter baseline drifted from the golden baseline had to
  # --no-verify (issue #334). cli_visual is excluded for the same reason as
  # in ci.yml (flutter-tests job).
  local conc="${FA_FLUTTER_TEST_CONCURRENCY:-$(detect_test_concurrency)}"
  echo "   concurrency: ${conc:-default}"
  if ! (cd flutter_app && flutter test ${conc:+--concurrency=$conc} --exclude-tags integration $(find test -name '*_test.dart' ! -path '*/golden/*' ! -path '*/cli_visual/*')); then
    echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — FLUTTER APP TESTS" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

  `media_models.json` slots (+ main-connection fallback) backing the
  `generate_image`/`speak`/`generate_music`/`generate_video` tools and the
  `jsr.fa.media.*` bridge; files land in `generated/`. `generate_video`
  rides the `videoGeneration` slot (required — no fallback): async
  OpenAI/OpenRouter `/videos` contract (POST job → poll `GET /videos/{id}`
  every 3s, 4-min cap, cancel-token aware → `unsigned_urls` or
  `GET /videos/{id}/content` mp4). Google (`generativelanguage`) endpoints
  switch to the native Gemini protocol by baseUrl: `speak` posts
  `/models/{model}:generateContent` (`x-goog-api-key` auth, LINEAR16 PCM
  24 kHz mono wrapped into a `.wav`), `generate_music` posts
  `/interactions` with `{model, input}` and deep-searches the response for
  base64 audio; the image/video slots answer an honest "not supported for

- `docs/subagents/` — the subagents-2.0 + long-term-memory master plan

  the checklists there as work lands.

  is the published privacy policy (`PRIVACY.md` in the repo root is the
  source text — keep both in sync; the onboarding privacy page links to
  `https://fa1.dev/privacy.html`).
- `scripts/` — codegen and quality-gate scripts.
- `browser_ext/` — Chrome MV3 extension pairing fa with the browser
  (issue #23): `sw/main.js` (entry, pairing storage, panel API,
  optional embedded-agent boot), `sw/bridge.js` (wire protocol v1
  client), `sw/ops.js` (browserReq op table), `sw/tabs.js` (task tab
  groups), `sw/cdp.js` (chrome.debugger trusted path), `sw/agent.js`
  (dart2js build artifact, gitignored, absent → bridge-only scaffold),
  `content/content.js` (isolated-world DOM ops), `panel/` (side panel).
  `dart/` is the `fa_browser_agent` package (path dep) compiled into
  `sw/agent.js` by `scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` — agent host,
  chrome.storage ExecutionEnv, provider streams (incl. deterministic
  `fake:` provider), DAP hub client. Tests: `browser_ext/dart/test`,
  `browser_ext/test` (node --test), `test/browser_ext/` (headless
  Chrome, integration tag). Docs: docs/browser-extension.md.
- `lib/src/browser/` — pure-Dart browser half: `bridge_protocol.dart`
  (wire protocol v1 — frame codec, ops/error codes, one-time

  tools over the injectable `BrowserController`; failures throw

  (docs/tool-availability.md); CLI surface in
  `lib/src/cli/browser_bridge_commands.dart` (`/browser connect|status`).
- `bin/serve_bridge.dart` — `fa serve --bridge [--port N] [--token T]`

  `browserReq`/`browserRes` correlation for the `browser_*` tools. The
  CLI mounts the same server in-process via `bin/fah.dart`'s
  `_FaBrowserBridgeHandle` (also the `BrowserController` seam).

`browserReq`/`browserRes` correlation for the `browser_*` tools. The
  CLI mounts the same server in-process via `bin/fah.dart`'s
  `_FaBrowserBridgeHandle` (also the `BrowserController` seam).

## Hard architecture rules

- `lib/` is pure Dart: **no `dart:io`** (must compile for web). The only
  `dart:io` entry points are `bin/` and `lib/io.dart`; file/process/network
  behind tools goes through the `ExecutionEnv` abstraction.

## Working in parallel: shared checkout + worktrees

The user's primary working directory is this checkout — they may be
=== 1692-1700
  reading or writing their working files. `agent_directory` lists
  siblings; `agent_message` to the relevant mailbox id. Their
  `memory/note/` files are theirs — leave them alone.

## Memory is part of the system prompt

Before starting any non-trivial task, **search memory first** to pick up
durable facts the user has accumulated across sessions — preferences,
gotchas, conventions, prior decisions. Cheap to query, often the
=== 1716-1724
shared-checkout rules, agent messaging fabric, known fragile files,
prior false-blame incidents. If the task touches one of those, search
before you start.

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

=== 1740-1746
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

## Prompts live outside Dart code

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
=== 1756-1763
  `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Re-run the script when
  codex-rs ships a new catalog so the picker / OAuth default stay current
  without a manual edit.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
=== 1920-1927
  duplication. `coverage-gardener.yml` measures the only-up CLI
  coverage weekly and files an ai-teammate "raise coverage to X" issue —
  the baseline itself only moves through a reviewed PR (issue #927).

## Cross-platform parity

Every shared setting and interactive prompt type must exist on BOTH the CLI
(`lib/src/cli/`) and the Flutter app (`flutter_app/lib/`) unless it is
=== 1998-2005
A host whose session scope differs from `ExecutionEnv.cwd` (the app's
mounted project folders) passes `sessionCwd` so the fabric groups mail by
workspace.

## Commits and releases

- Commit identity: human/AI contributors commit as `ai.teammate
  <agent.ai.native@gmail.com>` (history was rewritten to it — set
=== 2166-2172
  the committed goldens against `edits.images.list`. The daily
  `daily-publish.yml` play leg dispatches `build-mobile.yml` with
  `android_content=all`, so every release train redeploys the listing.

## Bench round 3 knobs (issue #1392)

The bench agent-timeout is no longer a wall-clock class: with
=== tail 2208-2212
pooled socket — a fresh-connect refusal is `connect_failed` and never
evicts the pool. The run report (`summary.py`) is green-with-note on
cancelled shards (`coverage: X/N`), splits latency p50/p95 by
concurrency level, and names any `agent_timeout` trial whose session
gaps never reached the stall threshold (score honesty).

# docs/ — canonical documentation index

Every subsystem essay moved out of `AGENTS.md` (gh-2181) landed here; the
slim `AGENTS.md` carries one-line summaries + `→ docs/...` pointers. New
docs must be listed in this index (pinned by `test/docs_link_check_test.dart`).

## Agent entry / conventions (docs/agents/)

| Doc | Covers |
| --- | --- |
| [agents/sdk-subsystems.md](agents/sdk-subsystems.md) | `lib/` subsystem reference (approval, tools, env, agent, trajectory, redact, hashline, compaction, lsp, mcp, model_roles, ttsr, skills, prompts, task, messaging, memory, a2a, cli, cube, hep, web_search, fa-clip) |
| [agents/flutter-app-subsystems.md](agents/flutter-app-subsystems.md) | `flutter_app/` UI/services/sandbox/goldens + `packages/fa_ui`, `site/`, `scripts/`, `docs/subagents/` pointers |
| [agents/parallel-worktrees.md](agents/parallel-worktrees.md) | shared-checkout policy, worktree placement rules |
| [agents/memory-usage.md](agents/memory-usage.md) | memory scopes, `memory_add` policy, host wiring |
| [agents/golden-tests.md](agents/golden-tests.md) | the golden-test mandate (coverage, fonts, frames, determinism, gates) |
| [agents/prompts.md](agents/prompts.md) | prompts-outside-Dart policy + codegen scripts |
| [agents/quality-gates.md](agents/quality-gates.md) | CI layout, gate stages, coverage/CRAP/duplication ratchets, flake quarantine |
| [agents/cross-platform-parity.md](agents/cross-platform-parity.md) | CLI/app parity + the 7-host capability matrix |
| [agents/commits-releases.md](agents/commits-releases.md) | commit identity, tagging, release draft/provenance, store pipelines, lockfiles |
| [agents/cli.md](agents/cli.md) | `fah`/`fa` CLI machinery, `/settings` hub, provider catalog |
| [agents/fa-ui.md](agents/fa-ui.md) | `packages/fa_ui/` reusable widget package |
| [agents/flutter-app.md](agents/flutter-app.md) | Flutter app structure, shim re-exports, widgets |
| [agents/js-apps.md](agents/js-apps.md) | JS apps platform, demo apps, runtime pinning |
| [agents/project-layout.md](agents/project-layout.md) | top-level tree + condensed subsystem map |
| [agents/providers.md](agents/providers.md) | provider auth flows (chatgpt / codemie / dial / openrouter) |
| [agents/services.md](agents/services.md) | Flutter app services one-liner |
| [agents/system-integrations.md](agents/system-integrations.md) | HomeKit, Calendar, CodeMie SSO |

## Core runtime & protocols

- [compaction.md](compaction.md) — compaction policy (AutoCompactor, branch summaries)
- [memory-churn.md](memory-churn.md) — long-term memory policy: durable facts, supersede, churn pitfalls
- [dap.md](dap.md) — DAP hub (debug adapters, fa_network bridging caveats §14)
- [cubes.md](cubes.md) — fa_cube sandbox profiles
- [redaction.md](redaction.md) — layered secret redaction
- [hep.md](hep.md) — HEP v1 harness event protocol
- [wire-protocol.md](wire-protocol.md) — wire protocol (framing, extensions)
- [embedding.md](embedding.md) — embeddings subsystem
- [media-models.md](media-models.md) — media model slots (image/audio/video)
- [proxy.md](proxy.md) — proxy support
- [logging.md](logging.md) — logging architecture
- [tool-availability.md](tool-availability.md) — tool availability gating families
- [backend-agent-mode.md](backend-agent-mode.md) — backend agent mode
- [session-hygiene.md](session-hygiene.md) — session hygiene rules
- [js-extensions.md](js-extensions.md) — JS extension registry
- [js-system-apis.md](js-system-apis.md) — JS system APIs
- [codex_websocket_adapter.md](codex_websocket_adapter.md) — Codex websocket adapter
- [migrating-from-claude-copilot-codex.md](migrating-from-claude-copilot-codex.md) — migration guide

## Surfaces & platforms

- [browser-extension.md](browser-extension.md) — Chrome MV3 extension + bridge (layout details moved in from AGENTS.md)
- [browser-extension-permissions.md](browser-extension-permissions.md) — extension permission surface
- [outlook-addin.md](outlook-addin.md) — Office/Outlook add-in (fa_office_agent, FA_HOST=office)
- [integrations/herdr.md](integrations/herdr.md) — herdr integration
- [android-automation.md](android-automation.md) / [android-readiness.md](android-readiness.md) — Android automation/readiness
- [web-rehosting.md](web-rehosting.md) — web rehosting

## Delivery, CI & performance

- [ci.md](ci.md) — CI workflows, release train, SM validation
- [ci-merge-queue-research.md](ci-merge-queue-research.md) — merge-queue research notes
- [bench.md](bench.md) — bench harnesses + round-3 timeout knobs (moved in from AGENTS.md)
- [performance-cli-tui.md](performance-cli-tui.md) — CLI/TUI performance
- [live-llm-testing.md](live-llm-testing.md) — live-model testing policy
- [leaderboard-submission.md](leaderboard-submission.md) — leaderboard submissions
- [github_widgets_oauth.md](github_widgets_oauth.md) — GitHub widgets OAuth
- [images.md](images.md) — image handling

## Plans

- [subagents/README.md](subagents/README.md) — subagents-2.0 + long-term-memory master plan (phased phase-0…phase-5 docs)
- [widgets/GOAL.md](widgets/GOAL.md) — widgets goal

# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  AGENTS.md SIZE CEILING — gh-2181. DO NOT RAISE WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL      ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# AGENTS.md is the agent ENTRY document: the harness carries it into the
# system prompt with a ~19 KB entry budget, so anything past that is
# invisible to agents in practice (gh-2181 measured the pre-slim file at
# 146405 B / 2201 lines — ~75% of it silently disabled its own tail).
#
# Ceiling: <= 300 lines AND <= 20480 bytes (20 KB). Comparison is <=
# (at-cap passes) — this is a documented divergence from
# scripts/check_changelog_size.sh, whose pub.dev cap is a strict
# less-than. Regrowth fix: move essays into docs/ (index:
# docs/README.md); the slim file stays a map + invariants + pointers.
#
# Callers (keep both wired — test/agents_md_size_guard_test.dart asserts

#     on docs/*.md commits, the exact commits that regrow the file;
#   - .github/workflows/ci.yml `static` job — whole-tree authority when
#     hooks are skipped (--no-verify).
#
# Usage: check_agents_md_size.sh [file] [max_lines] [max_bytes]
#   file       defaults to AGENTS.md;
#   max_lines  defaults to 300;
#   max_bytes  defaults to 20480 — overrides exist for tests.
#
# Exit 0 = within both ceilings. Exit 1 = missing file or over either
# ceiling, with a ::error:: annotation naming the fix.
set -euo pipefail

file="${1:-AGENTS.md}"
max_lines="${2:-300}"
max_bytes="${3:-20480}"

if [ ! -f "$file" ]; then
  echo "::error::check_agents_md_size.sh: $file does not exist — the agent entry document is missing."
  exit 1
fi

lines=$(wc -l < "$file")
bytes=$(wc -c < "$file")

if [ "$lines" -gt "$max_lines" ] || [ "$bytes" -gt "$max_bytes" ]; then
  echo "::error::$file is $lines lines / $bytes bytes — ceiling is <= ${max_lines} lines and <= ${max_bytes} bytes (gh-2181: the harness entry budget is ~19 KB, a larger file silently disables its own tail). Move the essays into docs/ (index: docs/README.md) and keep AGENTS.md a map + invariants + pointers."
  exit 1
fi
echo "$file: $lines lines / $bytes bytes <= ${max_lines}x${max_bytes} ceiling — ok"

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. This file is
the agent ENTRY document: the harness merges it into the system prompt with
a ~19 KB entry budget, so it must stay small enough to be fully visible.
Ceiling: **≤ 300 lines / ≤ 20 KB** — enforced by
`scripts/check_agents_md_size.sh` (pre-commit hook via `ci_fast_gate.sh` +
the CI `static` job). Subsystem essays live in `docs/` — index:
`docs/README.md`. Keep entries factual: paths, commands, invariants.

## Module map

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph CORE["SDK - flutter_agent_harness, pure Dart (lib/)"]
        AI["ai: providers, agent loop, sessions, compaction"]
        TOLS["tools: approval, redact, hashline, memory"]
        HOSTS["hosts: shared wiring, messaging, a2a, hub"]
    end
    subgraph PKG["packages/ - sibling Dart packages"]
        FAUI["fa_ui: widgets incl. trajectory"]
        DAP["dap_hub, fa_llm, fa_llm_mock"]
    end
    CLI["fa CLI - bin/ + lib/src/cli: TUI, slash commands, headless"]
    APP["Flutter app - flutter_app/: desktop, mobile, web shells"]
    EXT["Browser extension - browser_ext/ + lib/src/browser + serve_bridge"]
    OFFICE["Office add-in - office_addin/ + FA_HOST=office host"]
    GOLDEN["UI golden & styles - golden tests, themes, ui tests"]
    NETW["fa_network - external Go backend + network clients"]
    CORE --> CLI
    CORE --> APP
    CORE --> EXT
    PKG --> APP
    PKG --> CLI
    APP --> OFFICE
    CLI --> NETW
    APP --> NETW
    EXT --> NETW
    GOLDEN --> APP
    GOLDEN --> FAUI
```

## Project layout — one line per subsystem

Full subsystem reference: `docs/agents/sdk-subsystems.md` (SDK) +
`docs/agents/flutter-app-subsystems.md` (app/packages/repo-level).

**SDK core (`lib/`, pure Dart):**

- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers, session modes, per-tool overrides, critical-bash interceptor, per-turn grants.
- `lib/src/tools/` — `ask`/`request_secret`/media tools, `read` selectors + archives + sqlite, background shell jobs, availability + load modes.
- `lib/src/env/` — `ExecutionEnv` impls: `LocalShell` (setsid, killTree, drain caps, self-signal immunity), session-correlation vars, in-memory default.
- `lib/src/agent/` — FinalizeGate, tool pairing, session image registry.
- `lib/src/trajectory/` — trajectory ledger core; goldens under `test/trajectory/golden/`.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (prompt, tool args, output, logs).
- `lib/src/hashline/` — `[path#TAG]` patch language (SWAP/DEL/INS, stale-tag rejection).
- `lib/src/compaction/` — branch summarization + AutoCompactor → policy: `docs/compaction.md`.
- `lib/src/lsp/`, `lib/src/mcp/` — `lsp` + MCP protocol tooling (lazy servers, pure-Dart transports).
- `lib/src/model_roles/` — roles/fallbacks/keyring/watchdogs + provider catalog; `lib/src/ttsr/` — streaming-interrupt rules.
- `lib/src/skills/`, `lib/src/prompts/` — skills discovery; AGENTS/CLAUDE/GOAL/DESIGN auto-merge into the system prompt.
- `lib/src/task/`, `lib/src/messaging/`, `lib/src/session/attach/` — subagents, inbox fabric, attached sessions → `docs/subagents/README.md`.
- `lib/src/memory/` — long-term memory (hosted `flutter_agent_memory` package) → pitfalls: `docs/memory-churn.md`.
- `lib/src/a2a/` — Agent2Agent client/server/manager (`fa serve --a2a`).
- `bin/fah.dart` + `lib/src/cli/` — the `fa` CLI: REPL, slash commands, headless/serve modes → `docs/agents/cli.md`.
- `lib/src/cube/` — fa_cube sandbox profiles → `docs/cubes.md`; `lib/src/cli/hep.dart` — HEP event protocol → `docs/hep.md`.
- `lib/src/web_search/` — `web_search` (DDG keyless → keyed providers); `tools/fa-clip/` — native macOS pasteboard helper.

**packages/ + app shells:**

- `packages/fa_ui/` — reusable widgets (incl. trajectory) → `docs/agents/fa-ui.md`; `dap_hub`, `fa_llm`, `fa_llm_mock` → `docs/dap.md`.
- `flutter_app/` — the Flutter app (desktop/mobile/web) → `docs/agents/flutter-app.md`; services one-liner: `docs/agents/services.md`; JS apps: `docs/agents/js-apps.md`; HomeKit/Calendar/CodeMie: `docs/agents/system-integrations.md`.
- `browser_ext/` + `lib/src/browser/` + `bin/serve_bridge.dart` — browser extension + WebSocket bridge → `docs/browser-extension.md`.
- `office_addin/` + FA_HOST=office app host — Office add-in → `docs/outlook-addin.md`.
- `fa_network` — external Go backend bridged via the DAP hub (channel-id caveats: `docs/dap.md` §14).
- `site/`, `scripts/`, `docs/subagents/` — landing page (privacy sync), gates + codegen, subagents master plan → `docs/agents/flutter-app-subsystems.md`.

## Hard architecture rules (stay inline)

- `lib/` is pure Dart: **no `dart:io`** (must compile for web). The only
  `dart:io` entry points are `bin/` and `lib/io.dart`; file/process/network
  behind tools goes through the `ExecutionEnv` abstraction.
- Barrel `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart`: grouped **APPEND-ONLY** export
  sections — one `// ── <subsystem> ──` header per group, sorted by path
  within a group, new exports append to their group. No mini-barrels, no
  re-sorting (gh-1232).
- God-file ceiling: no `.dart` file over **2800** lines (crap4dart `loc`
  gate). Target < 2000 for primary files; split by concern into `part`
  files — never by extracting public API.

## Working in parallel (shared checkout + worktrees)

Do not modify files in this shared checkout unless the user asked; run no
heavy commands (full suites/analyze) in it; never `git stash` the user's
WIP; talk to peer agents through the messaging fabric, not their files.
Worktrees only if genuinely required — ask first, create detached under
`.worktrees/<name>/` from the remote tracking ref, remove when done.
Full policy: `docs/agents/parallel-worktrees.md`.

## Memory (footnote)

Before any non-trivial task, **search memory first** (`memory_search`,
then `memory_list` for fuzzy topics). Scopes: **project** = this repo
(committed, `memory/note/` — the user's files: read freely, write only via
`memory_add`), **user** = global/private. `memory_add` stores durable facts
only; supersede by delete + add — never leave solved problems to rot. The
host recomposes the `<memory>` prompt section after every add; tool wiring
is `memoryTools` + `lib/src/memory/`. Churn pitfalls: `docs/memory-churn.md`;
usage details: `docs/agents/memory-usage.md`.

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done: coverage first (`test/golden/` + `golden_guard_test.dart`
map), real fonts (`ensureGoldenFonts`), full frames (1280x800 / 390x844),
determinism, eyes on pixels after `--update-goldens`, green
`flutter test test/golden` + `scripts/check_goldens.py` (orphan snapshots
hard-fail). Full rules: `docs/agents/golden-tests.md`.

## Prompts live outside Dart code

Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (YAML frontmatter,
`{{token}}` placeholders) — never string literals in `.dart`. After
editing: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` regenerates the `.g.dart`
files (`test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart` gates drift); Codex catalog
refresh: `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Details:
`docs/agents/prompts.md`.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The hook is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI classifies
PRs through the same script (`--dry-run`) — one classifier, one threshold
set, hook/CI parity via `GATE_STAGE` markers. Path rules: docs/markdown/
prompts-only → size + analyze; lib/bin/test/pubspec → +tests, coverage,
CRAP, dup, dupx; `test/integration/**` → +integration-mock;
flutter_app/packages → +flutter; scripts/.github → everything. Invariants:

- analyze + format clean; `dart test` green — **deterministic-only**
  (mock LLM; live models never in the gate; `llm`-tagged files run only in
  the tag-only provider smoke + nightly).
- Line coverage of `lib/` ≥ 80%; jscpd < 1% core / < 3.7% app; cross-module
  dup < 0.31%; CRAP ratchet: core 12.0, app 30.0 (thresholds only-down);
  ≤ 2800 lines per `.dart` file; AGENTS.md ceiling (top of this file).
- Red-in-≥2-distinct-SHA-runs flakes quarantine via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json`; nightly keeps running quarantined files.

Full gate text: `docs/agents/quality-gates.md`; CI workflows: `docs/ci.md`.

## Cross-platform parity

Every shared setting and interactive prompt type exists on BOTH the CLI
and the Flutter app unless fundamentally impossible — then it MUST be in
`cliOnlySettings`/`appOnlySettings` (`lib/src/parity/settings_registry.dart`)
with the reason; run `dart test test/parity/`. Host capabilities (issue
#1079): every host-wiring capability declares its 7-host matrix state AT
BIRTH (`on` / `off(reason)` / `transport`) via `wireAgentCore` — `off` is
invisible everywhere; extensions are declared surface, SDK invariants have
no override point. Full rules: `docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md`.

## Commits and releases

- Commit as `ai.teammate <agent.ai.native@gmail.com>` (set repo-locally);
  subjects `type(scope): ...`. Release-path automation MUST use the
  fa-release-bot GitHub App token — never a PAT or `GITHUB_TOKEN`.
- Every push to main cuts an annotated tag (`scripts/auto_release.sh`);
  the tag is the single version source (pubspecs stay `0.0.0-dev`);
  releases go DRAFT-first and publish at `release-provenance` only with
  signed SHA256SUMS attached. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only (`## Unreleased`).
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag (first publish of a new
  package is manual); every lockfile is committed and enforced
  (`scripts/check_lockfiles.sh`); TestFlight external-group + store
  pipelines have required repo variables.

Full text: `docs/agents/commits-releases.md`.

## Bench

Bench knobs (agent timeouts, stall/watch, `FA_CONN_DEBUG`, hang replay,
report semantics) → `docs/bench.md` (round-3 knobs: issue #1392).

## Docs index

`docs/README.md` indexes every canonical doc (agents/, memory-churn,
compaction, dap, cubes, redaction, hep, ci, bench, browser-extension,
outlook-addin, …). New docs must be listed there.

arguments.content:
### What changed

Slimmed `AGENTS.md` from 146,405 B / 2,212 lines to **10,162 B / 184 lines** (≤300 lines / ≤20 KB ceiling) — one mermaid module map (SDK · CLI · Flutter app · packages · extension · office · fa_network · UI-golden/styles), one line per subsystem, all essays moved verbatim into `docs/`. Enforced by a new repo guard in the 2800-line-guard family: `scripts/check_agents_md_size.sh`, wired into `ci_fast_gate.sh` stage_analyze (pre-commit hook path, fires on docs-only commits) + the ci.yml `static` job.

### Key decisions

- Zero information loss audited by byte-diff: every moved range equals its new home (only 2 intended deltas — dangling cross-references re-pointed). Mapping (old AGENTS.md section → new home):
  - `## Project layout` L7–1034 (SDK) → `docs/agents/sdk-subsystems.md`; L1035–1620 (app/packages/repo) → `docs/agents/flutter-app-subsystems.md`; L1621–1651 (extension) → `docs/browser-extension.md` §Layout details
  - `## Working in parallel` → `docs/agents/parallel-worktrees.md` (invariant stays inline, 6 lines)
  - `## Memory` → `docs/agents/memory-usage.md` (footnote ≤15 lines stays inline); memory docs untouched
  - `## Golden tests` → `docs/agents/golden-tests.md` (mandate stays inline)
  - `## Prompts live outside Dart` → `docs/agents/prompts.md`
  - `## Quality gates` → `docs/agents/quality-gates.md` (invariants stay inline ≤10 lines)
  - `## Cross-platform parity` → `docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md`
  - `## Commits and releases` → `docs/agents/commits-releases.md`
  - `## Bench round 3 knobs` → `docs/bench.md` §Bench round 3 knobs (canonical home per card)
  - `## Hard architecture rules` stays inline (pure-Dart/no-`dart:io`/`lib/io.dart`, barrel APPEND-ONLY, 2800-line ceiling)
- New `docs/README.md` is the docs index (every doc AGENTS.md references is listed — pinned by test).
- Fixed a latent trap: the bare `agents/` `.gitignore` rule swallowed the new `docs/agents/*` files (they existed on disk but were invisible to git); added `!docs/agents/` + a guard test pinning "every docs/*.md must be git-tracked".
- `docs/agents/*` gains are new files; pre-existing docs only get additive moves/pointers (browser-extension.md, bench.md appends; flutter-app.md + project-layout.md one-line pointer fixes).

### How to verify

```bash
bash scripts/check_agents_md_size.sh                 # 184 lines / 10162 B <= 300x20480 — ok
dart test test/agents_md_size_guard_test.dart test/docs_link_check_test.dart   # 23 tests: size ceiling, wiring, docs links, index, mermaid, memory footnote, AC7 spot-checks
```

- AC7 usability pass (scripted, pinned in `test/docs_link_check_test.dart`): the slim file alone answers file-size gate value (2800), compaction policy location (`docs/compaction.md`), golden-test mandate (inline `MANDATORY`), memory scopes (project/user + churn pointer).
- Full unit suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` run locally; flutter/jscpd/crap4dart stages not runnable in this sandbox (tools absent) — SM validation CI is the safety net for those legs.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. This file is
the agent ENTRY document: the harness merges it into the system prompt with
a ~19 KB entry budget, so it must stay small enough to be fully visible.
Ceiling: **≤ 300 lines / ≤ 20 KB** — enforced by
`scripts/check_agents_md_size.sh` (pre-commit hook via `ci_fast_gate.sh` +
the CI `static` job). Subsystem essays live in `docs/` — index:
`docs/README.md`. Keep entries factual: paths, commands, invariants.

## Module map

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph CORE["SDK - flutter_agent_harness, pure Dart (lib/)"]
        AI["ai: providers, agent loop, sessions, compaction"]
        TOLS["tools: approval, redact, hashline, memory"]
        HOSTS["hosts: shared wiring, messaging, a2a, hub"]
    end
    subgraph PKG["packages/ - sibling Dart packages"]
        FAUI["fa_ui: widgets incl. trajectory"]
        DAP["dap_hub, fa_llm, fa_llm_mock"]
    end
    CLI["fa CLI - bin/ + lib/src/cli: TUI, slash commands, headless"]
    APP["Flutter app - flutter_app/: desktop, mobile, web shells"]
    EXT["Browser extension - browser_ext/ + lib/src/browser + serve_bridge"]
    OFFICE["Office add-in - office_addin/ + FA_HOST=office host"]
    GOLDEN["UI golden & styles - golden tests, themes, ui tests"]
    NETW["fa_network - external Go backend + network clients"]
    CORE --> CLI
    CORE --> APP
    CORE --> EXT
    PKG --> APP
    PKG --> CLI
    APP --> OFFICE
    CLI --> NETW
    APP --> NETW
    EXT --> NETW
    GOLDEN --> APP
    GOLDEN --> FAUI
```

## Project layout — one line per subsystem

Full subsystem reference: `docs/agents/sdk-subsystems.md` (SDK) +
`docs/agents/flutter-app-subsystems.md` (app/packages/repo-level).

**SDK core (`lib/`, pure Dart):**

- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers, session modes, per-tool overrides, critical-bash interceptor, per-turn grants.
- `lib/src/tools/` — `ask`/`request_secret`/media tools, `read` selectors + archives + sqlite, background shell jobs, availability + load modes.
- `lib/src/env/` — `ExecutionEnv` impls: `LocalShell` (setsid, killTree, drain caps, self-signal immunity), session-correlation vars, in-memory default.
- `lib/src/agent/` — FinalizeGate, tool pairing, session image registry.
- `lib/src/trajectory/` — trajectory ledger core; goldens under `test/trajectory/golden/`.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (prompt, tool args, output, logs).
- `lib/src/hashline/` — `[path#TAG]` patch language (SWAP/DEL/INS, stale-tag rejection).
- `lib/src/compaction/` — branch summarization + AutoCompactor → policy: `docs/compaction.md`.
- `lib/src/lsp/`, `lib/src/mcp/` — `lsp` + MCP protocol tooling (lazy servers, pure-Dart transports).
- `lib/src/model_roles/` — roles/fallbacks/keyring/watchdogs + provider catalog; `lib/src/ttsr/` — streaming-interrupt rules.
- `lib/src/skills/`, `lib/src/prompts/` — skills discovery; AGENTS/CLAUDE/GOAL/DESIGN auto-merge into the system prompt.
- `lib/src/task/`, `lib/src/messaging/`, `lib/src/session/attach/` — subagents, inbox fabric, attached sessions → `docs/subagents/README.md`.
- `lib/src/memory/` — long-term memory (hosted `flutter_agent_memory` package) → pitfalls: `docs/memory-churn.md`.
- `lib/src/a2a/` — Agent2Agent client/server/manager (`fa serve --a2a`).
- `bin/fah.dart` + `lib/src/cli/` — the `fa` CLI: REPL, slash commands, headless/serve modes → `docs/agents/cli.md`.
- `lib/src/cube/` — fa_cube sandbox profiles → `docs/cubes.md`; `lib/src/cli/hep.dart` — HEP event protocol → `docs/hep.md`.
- `lib/src/web_search/` — `web_search` (DDG keyless → keyed providers); `tools/fa-clip/` — native macOS pasteboard helper.

**packages/ + app shells:**

- `packages/fa_ui/` — reusable widgets (incl. trajectory) → `docs/agents/fa-ui.md`; `dap_hub`, `fa_llm`, `fa_llm_mock` → `docs/dap.md`.
- `flutter_app/` — the Flutter app (desktop/mobile/web) → `docs/agents/flutter-app.md`; services one-liner: `docs/agents/services.md`; JS apps: `docs/agents/js-apps.md`; HomeKit/Calendar/CodeMie: `docs/agents/system-integrations.md`.
- `browser_ext/` + `lib/src/browser/` + `bin/serve_bridge.dart` — browser extension + WebSocket bridge → `docs/browser-extension.md`.
- `office_addin/` + FA_HOST=office app host — Office add-in → `docs/outlook-addin.md`.
- `fa_network` — external Go backend bridged via the DAP hub (channel-id caveats: `docs/dap.md` §14).
- `site/`, `scripts/`, `docs/subagents/` — landing page (privacy sync), gates + codegen, subagents master plan → `docs/agents/flutter-app-subsystems.md`.

## Hard architecture rules (stay inline)

- `lib/` is pure Dart: **no `dart:io`** (must compile for web). The only
  `dart:io` entry points are `bin/` and `lib/io.dart`; file/process/network
  behind tools goes through the `ExecutionEnv` abstraction.
- Barrel `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart`: grouped **APPEND-ONLY** export
  sections — one `// ── <subsystem> ──` header per group, sorted by path
  within a group, new exports append to their group. No mini-barrels, no
  re-sorting (gh-1232).
- God-file ceiling: no `.dart` file over **2800** lines (crap4dart `loc`
  gate). Target < 2000 for primary files; split by concern into `part`
  files — never by extracting public API.

## Working in parallel (shared checkout + worktrees)

Do not modify files in this shared checkout unless the user asked; run no
heavy commands (full suites/analyze) in it; never `git stash` the user's
WIP; talk to peer agents through the messaging fabric, not their files.
Worktrees only if genuinely required — ask first, create detached under
`.worktrees/<name>/` from the remote tracking ref, remove when done.
Full policy: `docs/agents/parallel-worktrees.md`.

## Memory (footnote)

Before any non-trivial task, **search memory first** (`memory_search`,
then `memory_list` for fuzzy topics). Scopes: **project** = this repo
(committed, `memory/note/` — the user's files: read freely, write only via
`memory_add`), **user** = global/private. `memory_add` stores durable facts
only; supersede by delete + add — never leave solved problems to rot. The
host recomposes the `<memory>` prompt section after every add; tool wiring
is `memoryTools` + `lib/src/memory/`. Churn pitfalls: `docs/memory-churn.md`;
usage details: `docs/agents/memory-usage.md`.

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done: coverage first (`test/golden/` + `golden_guard_test.dart`
map), real fonts (`ensureGoldenFonts`), full frames (1280x800 / 390x844),
determinism, eyes on pixels after `--update-goldens`, green
`flutter test test/golden` + `scripts/check_goldens.py` (orphan snapshots
hard-fail). Full rules: `docs/agents/golden-tests.md`.

## Prompts live outside Dart code

Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (YAML frontmatter,
`{{token}}` placeholders) — never string literals in `.dart`. After
editing: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` regenerates the `.g.dart`
files (`test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart` gates drift); Codex catalog
refresh: `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Details:
`docs/agents/prompts.md`.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The hook is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI classifies
PRs through the same script (`--dry-run`) — one classifier, one threshold
set, hook/CI parity via `GATE_STAGE` markers. Path rules: docs/markdown/
prompts-only → size + analyze; lib/bin/test/pubspec → +tests, coverage,
CRAP, dup, dupx; `test/integration/**` → +integration-mock;
flutter_app/packages → +flutter; scripts/.github → everything. Invariants:

- analyze + format clean; `dart test` green — **deterministic-only**
  (mock LLM; live models never in the gate; `llm`-tagged files run only in
  the tag-only provider smoke + nightly).
- Line coverage of `lib/` ≥ 80%; jscpd < 1% core / < 3.7% app; cross-module
  dup < 0.31%; CRAP ratchet: core 12.0, app 30.0 (thresholds only-down);
  ≤ 2800 lines per `.dart` file; AGENTS.md ceiling (top of this file).
- Red-in-≥2-distinct-SHA-runs flakes quarantine via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json`; nightly keeps running quarantined files.

Full gate text: `docs/agents/quality-gates.md`; CI workflows: `docs/ci.md`.

## Cross-platform parity

Every shared setting and interactive prompt type exists on BOTH the CLI
and the Flutter app unless fundamentally impossible — then it MUST be in
`cliOnlySettings`/`appOnlySettings` (`lib/src/parity/settings_registry.dart`)
with the reason; run `dart test test/parity/`. Host capabilities (issue
#1079): every host-wiring capability declares its 7-host matrix state AT
BIRTH (`on` / `off(reason)` / `transport`) via `wireAgentCore` — `off` is
invisible everywhere; extensions are declared surface, SDK invariants have
no override point. Full rules: `docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md`.

## Commits and releases

- Commit as `ai.teammate <agent.ai.native@gmail.com>` (set repo-locally);
  subjects `type(scope): ...`. Release-path automation MUST use the
  fa-release-bot GitHub App token — never a PAT or `GITHUB_TOKEN`.
- Every push to main cuts an annotated tag (`scripts/auto_release.sh`);
  the tag is the single version source (pubspecs stay `0.0.0-dev`);
  releases go DRAFT-first and publish at `release-provenance` only with
  signed SHA256SUMS attached. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only (`## Unreleased`).
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag (first publish of a new
  package is manual); every lockfile is committed and enforced
  (`scripts/check_lockfiles.sh`); TestFlight external-group + store
  pipelines have required repo variables.

Full text: `docs/agents/commits-releases.md`.

## Bench

Bench knobs (agent timeouts, stall/watch, `FA_CONN_DEBUG`, hang replay,
report semantics) → `docs/bench.md` (round-3 knobs: issue #1392).

## Docs index

`docs/README.md` indexes every canonical doc (agents/, memory-churn,
compaction, dap, cubes, redaction, hep, ci, bench, browser-extension,
outlook-addin, …). New docs must be listed there.
